messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] staging environment — tag: release-v0.12.3-rc3, commit: 9b3f7ea. Change window: 02:00-02:30 UTC. Initiated by maya. Planned rollout: 25% -> 100% over 10m canary. Release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v0.12.3-rc3 :rocket:

maya: starting monitors + smoke set. ping me if latency spikes.

ci-bot: CI checks: unit ✅ integration ✅ e2e (staging) ✅. Build artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/release-v0.12.3-rc3.tar.gz

alex: pinning runtime image to rti-1.3.2 to avoid new kernel regressions. config change: runtime_image=rti-1.3.2 :eyes:

priscilla: heads up — short DB migration was scheduled at 02:10 UTC that touches session table. Can we freeze traffic for 02:08-02:15? If not, I can move the migration to after smoke tests.

oncall: suggest proceed with 25% canary, hold for 5m observation and then continue. I'll be oncall and watching logs.

deploy-bot: [ROLLOUT] canary at 25% complete. Allocated 6 staging workers. Health: 200/200, avg latency +2ms. Waiting 5m for observation.

maya: looks clean so far. no errors in traces.

priscilla: moving migration to +15m, thanks — proceed.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY COMPLETE] staging rollout reached 100% at tag release-v0.12.3-rc3. Duration: 12m. Instances updated: 24 -> 30. Smoke tests: pass. Post-deploy checks: cost metrics and trace sampling started. :tada:

alex: quick note — pinned runtime in config repo: https://git.redwood.internal/configs/commit/ab12cd34

priscilla: found one flaky API test in integration suite — nonblocking for now, filing ticket RT: #INC-4567

maya: agreed, we'll hold for prod rollout until the flaky test is addressed in next patch. For now marking staging as stable.

deploy-bot: [ANNOTATION] rollback plan available: rollback -> tag release-v0.12.2, estimated duration 6m. If anyone requests rollback, please react with :warning: in this thread.
